source: Traced by hand and by color from USGS NAIP aerial photos (public domain), to fill in what OpenStreetMap doesn't have yet.

unsure.1: numbered 1 from the card length and the clubhouse; tee put at the far end of the strip by the clubhouse, and a round mown patch partway along it may be a tee or a practice green
unsure.9: numbered 9 because it finishes beside the clubhouse and fits the card length; can't be checked against holes 2-8
unsure.10: tee assumed at the south-west end of the fairway beside the range; no clear tee boxes seen, traced shorter than the card's back tee
unsure.13: tee assumed on the narrow strip of grass north of the lake, playing across the water; no clear tee boxes seen
unsure.15: bends added: the fairway runs west along the south of the houses and round the lake's south-west corner to the green
unsure.17: tee put at the west end of a long tee strip next to the 16th green; that strip may belong to the 15th instead
unsure.18: back tee put on the grass south of the big lake to fit the card's long length; not clearly visible
unsure.3: back tee placed at the far end of faint tee pads south of the green; the card's longest yardage (268) does not fit any tee seen
unsure.5: tee placed at small round pads just west of the 4th green; fairway bends round the north and down the west side to the green by the lake
unsure.6: tee pads beside the road south-west of the lake; which pad is the back tee is a guess
unsure.7: tee placed at the west end of the strip south of the canal; traces shorter than the card's longest yardage
unsure.8: tee placed on the grass east of the 7th green, playing across the canal and east along the south half of the big fairway to the green by the road
unsure.all: Holes 2-8 traced on a wider photo that shows the part west of the road; their order is read as a loop from the road crossing near the 1st green back to the green beside the road before the 9th tee, fitting the card's pars and lengths, but no hole map was read
